datasets.name: ds_unified_rba_findings
queryLines:
WITH h01_ord AS (
  SELECT src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip) AS target, flow_ts, octetTotalCount AS b_out,
         LAG(octetTotalCount) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip) ORDER BY flow_ts) AS prev_out
  FROM workspace.default.artex_ipfix_flows
  WHERE dst_port = 443 AND reverseOctetTotalCount BETWEEN 300 AND 50000
),
h01 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_01_SAWTOOTH_LLM_PROXY' AS hunt_id, 'Network / IPFIX' AS surface, 70 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         src_ip, target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN prev_out IS NOT NULL AND (b_out - prev_out) >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING) || ' growing turns, peak=' || CAST(MAX(b_out) AS STRING) || 'B' AS evidence
  FROM h01_ord
  GROUP BY src_ip, target
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN prev_out IS NOT NULL AND (b_out - prev_out) >= 1500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4
     AND MAX(b_out) >= 12000 AND (MAX(b_out) * 1.0 / GREATEST(MIN(b_out), 1)) >= 2.5
),
h02 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_02_CONSOLE_RAW_IP_TLS' AS hunt_id, 'Network / IPFIX' AS surface, 75 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         src_ip, dst_ip || ':' || CAST(dst_port AS STRING) AS target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'app=' || CAST(MAX(silkAppLabel) AS STRING) || ', ja4=' || COALESCE(MAX(ja4), '') AS evidence
  FROM workspace.default.artex_ipfix_flows
  WHERE (silkAppLabel IN (80, 443) AND dst_port IN (8787, 8788, 8790, 8890, 18899))
     OR (SUBSTRING(ja4, 4, 1) = 'i' AND dst_port = 443 AND octetTotalCount >= 12000)
  GROUP BY src_ip, dst_ip, dst_port
),
h03 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_03_JA4_WHIPLASH' AS hunt_id, 'Web / JA4+' AS surface, 70 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip) AS target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'ja4=' || CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT ja4) AS STRING) || ', uas=' || CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT http_ua) AS STRING) || ', errs=' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING) AS evidence
  FROM workspace.default.artex_http_flows
  WHERE src_ip NOT IN ('198.51.100.250')
  GROUP BY src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip)
  HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ja4) >= 3 OR COUNT(DISTINCT ja4h) >= 3)
     AND (COUNT(DISTINCT http_ua) <= 1 OR SUM(CASE WHEN http_status >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3)
),
h04 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_04_JA4X_SELF_SIGNED' AS hunt_id, 'TLS / Certs' AS surface, 65 AS risk_score, 'hunt' AS alert_tier,
         MIN(src_ip) AS src_ip, 'ja4x_c=' || COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ja4x, '_'), 2), '') || ' | ja4s=' || COALESCE(ja4s, '') AS target, COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS event_count,
         'self_signed_cluster_ips=' || CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS STRING) AS evidence
  FROM workspace.default.artex_ssl_flows
  WHERE ja4x IS NOT NULL AND ja4x <> ''
    AND COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ja4x, '_'), 2), '') <> ''
    AND GET(SPLIT(ja4x, '_'), 0) = GET(SPLIT(ja4x, '_'), 1)
  GROUP BY COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ja4x, '_'), 2), ''), COALESCE(ja4s, '')
),
h05 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_05_SERVER_CALLBACK' AS hunt_id, 'Cross-Direction' AS surface, 90 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         out_f.src_ip AS src_ip, in_h.src_ip || ':' || CAST(MAX(out_f.dst_port) AS STRING) AS target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'probing_ip=' || in_h.src_ip || ' probed ' || MAX(in_h.http_path) AS evidence
  FROM workspace.default.artex_http_flows in_h
  JOIN workspace.default.artex_ipfix_flows out_f
    ON out_f.src_ip = in_h.dst_ip AND out_f.dst_ip = in_h.src_ip
   AND out_f.flow_ts >= in_h.flow_ts AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(out_f.flow_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(in_h.flow_ts)) <= 600
  GROUP BY out_f.src_ip, in_h.src_ip
),
h06 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_06_OOB_DNS_CALLBACK' AS hunt_id, 'DNS OOB' AS surface, 85 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         d.src_ip AS src_ip, d.dns_query AS target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'after_probe_by=' || MIN(h.src_ip) AS evidence
  FROM workspace.default.artex_http_flows h
  JOIN workspace.default.artex_dns_flows d
    ON d.src_ip = h.dst_ip AND d.flow_ts >= h.flow_ts AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(d.flow_ts) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(h.flow_ts)) <= 90
  WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(d.dns_query, '\\.'), 0), '')) RLIKE '^[a-f0-9]{10,}$'
    AND LOWER(d.dns_query) NOT LIKE '%.cloudfront.net'
    AND LOWER(d.dns_query) NOT LIKE '%.amazonaws.com'
  GROUP BY d.src_ip, d.dns_query
),
h07 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_07_LATERAL_FANOUT' AS hunt_id, 'Lateral / SMB' AS surface, 80 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         src_ip, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) AS STRING) || ' internal peers' AS target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'span_s=' || CAST(CAST(UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(flow_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(flow_ts)) AS INT) AS STRING) AS evidence
  FROM workspace.default.artex_ipfix_flows
  WHERE dst_port IN (445, 5985, 5986, 135, 3389, 22) AND src_ip <> dst_ip
  GROUP BY src_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT dst_ip) >= 4 AND (UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MAX(flow_ts)) - UNIX_TIMESTAMP(MIN(flow_ts))) <= 120
),
h08_tag AS (
  SELECT src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip) AS target, NULLIF(ja4, '') AS ja4, NULLIF(ja4h, '') AS ja4h, http_status,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(http_ua) LIKE '%curl/%' THEN 'curl' WHEN LOWER(http_ua) LIKE '%python-httpx%' THEN 'python' WHEN LOWER(http_ua) LIKE '%go-http-client%' THEN 'go' WHEN LOWER(http_ua) LIKE '%chrome/%' OR LOWER(http_ua) LIKE '%firefox/%' THEN 'browser' ELSE 'other' END AS ua_fam,
         CASE WHEN LOWER(http_ua) LIKE '%mozilla/5.0%' AND LOWER(ja4h) RLIKE '^[a-z]{2}[0-9]{2}nn0[0-5]0000_' AND UPPER(http_method) <> 'CONNECT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_imp
  FROM workspace.default.artex_http_flows
  WHERE src_ip NOT IN ('198.51.100.250')
),
h08 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_08_JA4_PROXY_OR_IMPERSONATION' AS hunt_id, 'Web / JA4+' AS surface, 75 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         src_ip, target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT ja4) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ja4h) >= 3 THEN 'JA4_PROXY_COLLAPSE' ELSE 'BROWSER_UA_IMPERSONATION' END AS evidence
  FROM h08_tag
  GROUP BY src_ip, target
  HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ja4) = 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ja4h) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ua_fam) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN http_status BETWEEN 400 AND 499 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3)
      OR SUM(is_imp) >= 2
),
h09_ord AS (
  SELECT src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip) || http_path AS target, flow_ts, http_status, bytes_out,
         LAG(bytes_out) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip), http_path ORDER BY flow_ts) AS prev_b,
         LAG(http_status) OVER (PARTITION BY src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip), http_path ORDER BY flow_ts) AS prev_s
  FROM workspace.default.artex_http_flows
  WHERE http_status IN (200, 500, 502)
),
h09 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_09_RUBY2SHELL_CRASH_LOOP' AS hunt_id, 'Web / App' AS surface, 80 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         src_ip, target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'monotonic_5xx_crashes=' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN http_status IN (500, 502) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING) AS evidence
  FROM h09_ord
  GROUP BY src_ip, target
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN http_status IN (500, 502) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN http_status IN (500, 502) AND prev_s IN (500, 502) AND bytes_out > prev_b THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
     AND SUM(CASE WHEN http_status = 200 AND prev_s IN (500, 502) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
),
h10_ext AS (
  SELECT service_principal_name AS sp_name, ip_address AS src_ip, resource_display_name AS res,
         CASE WHEN ip_address LIKE '%:%' THEN COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, ':'), 0), '') || ':' || COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, ':'), 1), '') || ':' || COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, ':'), 2), '') ELSE COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, '\\.'), 0), '') || '.' || COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, '\\.'), 1), '') END AS net_prefix
  FROM workspace.default.artex_entra_sp_logs
  WHERE result_type IN ('0', '200') AND NOT (ip_address RLIKE '^(10\\.|127\\.|169\\.254\\.|192\\.168\\.|172\\.(1[6-9]|2[0-9]|3[0-1])\\.|::1$|fe80:|f[cd][0-9a-f]{2}:)')
),
h10 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_10_STORM0940_SP_REPLAY' AS hunt_id, 'Identity / Entra' AS surface, 85 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         MIN(src_ip) AS src_ip, sp_name AS target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'prefixes=' || CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT net_prefix) AS STRING) || ', resources=' || CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT res) AS STRING) AS evidence
  FROM h10_ext
  GROUP BY sp_name
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT net_prefix) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT res) >= 2
),
h11 AS (
  SELECT 'HUNT_11_GCP_BITRISE_MULTI_SA' AS hunt_id, 'Cloud / GCP' AS surface, 90 AS risk_score, 'alert' AS alert_tier,
         caller_ip AS src_ip, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT principal_email) AS STRING) || ' GCP SAs' AS target, COUNT(*) AS event_count,
         'denied=' || CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN grpc_code = 7 THEN method_name END) AS STRING) || ', secret_ok=' || CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(method_name) LIKE '%accesssecretversion%' AND grpc_code = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS STRING) AS evidence
  FROM workspace.default.artex_gcp_audit_logs
  WHERE LOWER(principal_email) LIKE '%.gserviceaccount.com'
    AND LOWER(principal_email) NOT LIKE '%terraform%'
    AND LOWER(principal_email) NOT LIKE '%@gcp-sa-%'
    AND LOWER(principal_email) NOT LIKE '%@cloudservices.gserviceaccount.com'
    AND LOWER(principal_email) NOT LIKE '%-system@%'
  GROUP BY caller_ip
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT principal_email) >= 3
      OR COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN grpc_code = 7 THEN method_name END) >= 5
      OR (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN grpc_code = 7 THEN method_name END) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(method_name) LIKE '%accesssecretversion%' AND grpc_code = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1)
)
SELECT * FROM h01 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h02 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h03 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h04
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h05 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h06 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h07 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h08
UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h09 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h10 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM h11
ORDER BY risk_score DESC, hunt_id ASC

datasets.name: ds_hourly_volume
queryLines:
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', flow_ts) AS hour_bucket, 'IPFIX / Network' AS surface, COUNT(*) AS events FROM workspace.default.artex_ipfix_flows GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', flow_ts) AS hour_bucket, 'HTTP / JA4+' AS surface, COUNT(*) AS events FROM workspace.default.artex_http_flows GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', created_ts) AS hour_bucket, 'Entra SP' AS surface, COUNT(*) AS events FROM workspace.default.artex_entra_sp_logs GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT DATE_TRUNC('HOUR', event_ts) AS hour_bucket, 'GCP Audit' AS surface, COUNT(*) AS events FROM workspace.default.artex_gcp_audit_logs GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY hour_bucket ASC

datasets.name: ds_sawtooth_profile
datasets.displayName: Sawtooth TLS 1.3 Context Growth vs Benign Baseline
queryLines:
SELECT flow_ts, src_ip, COALESCE(NULLIF(sslServerName, ''), dst_ip) AS target, octetTotalCount AS bytes_out, reverseOctetTotalCount AS bytes_in
FROM workspace.default.artex_ipfix_flows
WHERE src_ip IN ('10.20.30.40', '10.90.1.5') AND dst_port = 443
ORDER BY flow_ts ASC

datasets.name: ds_gcp_audit_activity
datasets.displayName: GCP Cloud Audit — Service Account Activity & PERMISSION_DENIED Breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT caller_ip, principal_email, service_name,
       COUNT(*) AS total_calls,
       SUM(CASE WHEN grpc_code = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS permission_denied_calls,
       SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(method_name) LIKE '%accesssecretversion%' AND grpc_code = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS secret_reads_ok
FROM workspace.default.artex_gcp_audit_logs
GROUP BY caller_ip, principal_email, service_name
ORDER BY permission_denied_calls DESC, secret_reads_ok DESC, total_calls DESC

datasets.name: ds_entra_sp_summary
datasets.displayName: Entra ID Service Principal — /16 Prefix Diversity vs Resource Fanout
queryLines:
SELECT service_principal_name,
       COUNT(*) AS sign_ins,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ip_address) AS distinct_ips,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ip_address LIKE '%:%' THEN COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, ':'), 0), '') || ':' || COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, ':'), 1), '') || ':' || COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, ':'), 2), '') ELSE COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, '\\.'), 0), '') || '.' || COALESCE(GET(SPLIT(ip_address, '\\.'), 1), '') END) AS distinct_16_prefixes,
       COUNT(DISTINCT resource_display_name) AS distinct_resources
FROM workspace.default.artex_entra_sp_logs
WHERE result_type IN ('0', '200')
GROUP BY service_principal_name
ORDER BY distinct_16_prefixes DESC, distinct_resources DESC
